# Timer:running

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.0</span></div>

Return the running state of the timer.

```lua
local running = timer:running()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

running (boolean)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
print(timer:running())
```
